steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So this is your idea of "discussion"?
In an instant, the small guest room fills with people. A wheelchair blocks the main doorway, while the Immortal Healer and Young Master Brocade take their positions on either side.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Still playing dumb? I'm talking about that little wretch who always clings to you. That beggar girl, Shuang'er. Where have you stashed her? Hand her over, now!

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Please. I haven't yet explained the situation to our young friend.
The Princess steadies the two men flanking her, especially the disheveled and furious doctor, before taking another step closer to you.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: I fear you've been kept in the dark, young friend. Miss Shuang'er attempted to assassinate Doctor Yin under the cover of darkness... If he hadn't witnessed it himself last night, we never would have known that child possessed such... remarkable skills.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Shuang'er? But Doctor Yin is standing right here, perfectly unharmed. In fact, he seems to have had plenty of energy left over to break down my door.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Precisely. The attempt failed. Having exposed herself, she wouldn't dare show her face again. If I'm not mistaken... Miss Shuang'er never returned last night, did she?
Her meaningful tone reveals she knows more than she lets on. Still, you do not take the bait.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Oh? For someone who claims her innocence, you seem awfully interested in the comings and goings of my room.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: No need for barbed remarks. Tell me, what do you make of this?
Yin Yansheng gives a cold snort. Producing a familiar small porcelain bottle, he hurls it to the ground before you.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: I doubt you realize, young friend, how valuable these medicinal ingredients are. Only someone with considerable means could afford such medicine...
She lets her gaze sweep across the manor, deliberately, before it catches on the elevated meeting hall, the very place where you meet the manor master for the first time.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Similar age. A conveniently frail constitution. A clear motive. Tell me, what are the odds of such a coincidence? We have both witness testimony and physical evidence. Surely you're not naive enough to ignore all that?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not naive enough to ignore all the other convenient brandings and leap to conclusions based on one medicine bottle, either. I'd rather ask you. What did you do to her, and how exactly did you get your hands on that bottle?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As for your so-called culprit, Shuang'er has been by my side since before we even entered this manor. She had no opportunity.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: If she truly possesses such divine martial arts, long-distance communication and remote manipulation would be no difficult feat.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Oh? Then by that logic, the three of you working together could just as easily have accomplished everything you're accusing her of. General Invincible is still buried under that snow pile in the courtyard, by the way. Shall we go investigate that again together?

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Keep playing stubborn. Right now, you have two choices.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: One: Work with us to capture that witch and get to the bottom of these murders and the codex. Or two...

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: You admit you knew the truth all along, that you're that beggar girl's accomplice!
As they speak, the three of them are already shifting into an encircling formation. Even if you activate your shackles now, their coordinated close-range assault will seal your fate.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why mince words? If I work with you, I help hunt down Shuang'er. If I'm her accomplice, I'm the first to be eliminated.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: You are a sharp one. Since Shuang'er trusts you most, surely you can help us locate her and put an end to this mess. How this plays out... depends entirely on you, young friend.
[Flashback]
[End of Flashback]
Can Shuang'er truly be trusted completely? On that point, you still cannot decide. But the true nature of the people before you? That you now understand perfectly well.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm hardly in a position to make enemies of all three of you over her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But once we find Shuang... once we find the witch, what then?

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Then we make her talk. We find out where the codex is hidden, and the strong take all. Surely you didn't travel all the way to Northsnow Manor without an interest in that?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Naturally, I'd like to witness the secret that could overturn the entire Eastian martial world. However...
A sudden shock seizes you. Your pupils contract as your gaze locks on something behind them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Manor Master?! Why are you here?!
Instantly, the three people's faces harden. They whip around as one, but the courtyard behind them stands completely empty.
They don't have time to turn back. You lash out, kicking the charcoal brazier. Blazing coals spray in every direction as smoke erupts with a roar, igniting the curtains and bamboo mats.
The thick smoke separates you. Seizing the moment, you spin, hurl yourself through the window, and disappear into the swirling snow.

The manor's brick paths are wet and slippery; you nearly fall several times, but you do not stop running. No matter how much truth lies in what those people said, you no longer have the luxury of playing it safe.
The only consolation is that Shuang'er should not yet have fallen into their hands. You have to find her before they do.
The snowstorm rages more fiercely than it has in days. Heaven and earth are caught in a vast, endless white vortex.
And inside the guest room, ignited by scattered coals, a piece of paper left sometime during the night is also consumed by the flames, its crooked, trembling handwriting turning to ash.

Red Plum Denunciation IV In darkness you reap lives like weeds, Building monuments to your heroic deeds. Ten thousand scrolls of glory earned, Yet innocent souls as payment burned. Where you contend for supremacy, No blade of grass grows free.
